name: r2b4_p1_ekf_stationary_covariance_fix_20260930
root_cause: The EKF applies the full moving process-noise model every control tick even when trusted encoder and gyro evidence jointly prove standstill; stationary gyro-bias state adaptation also lacked the matching covariance transform.
safety_invariants: fresh non-stationary wheel or gyro-rate evidence revokes stationary mode immediately
stationary authority expires 50 ms after the last joint evidence
gyro-bias process noise remains active during stationary prediction
existing ZUPT, NIS, LiDAR and localization fail-closed gates remain active
